name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tabs on a 1px line, with an indicator that slides to the selected tab.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import "../core/vitehub.css";
import "./tabs.css";
import { Tabs as TabsRoot } from "@ui-sdk/vue/tabs";
import type { TabsEmits, TabsProps, TabsSlots } from "./types.ts";

const model = defineModel<string>();
const { defaultValue, orientation = "horizontal" } = defineProps<TabsProps>();
defineEmits<TabsEmits>();
defineSlots<TabsSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <TabsRoot v-model:value="model" data-slot="tabs" :default-value="defaultValue" :orientation="orientation"><slot /></TabsRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { TabsIndicator, TabsList as TabsListPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/tabs";
import type { TabsListSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<TabsListSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <TabsListPart data-slot="tabs-list">
    <slot />
    <TabsIndicator data-slot="tabs-indicator" />
  </TabsListPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { TabsTab } from "@ui-sdk/vue/tabs";
import type { TabsTriggerSlots, TabsTriggerProps } from "./types.ts";
const { value, disabled = false } = defineProps<TabsTriggerProps>();
defineSlots<TabsTriggerSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <TabsTab :value="value" :disabled="disabled || undefined">
    <!-- The ui-sdk part writes its own data-slot. The render slot keeps the item's name on the element. -->
    <template #render="{ props: part, children }">
      <button v-bind="part" data-slot="tabs-trigger"><component :is="children" /></button>
    </template>
    <slot />
  </TabsTab>
</template>
